method: NO JUDGES RUN -- deliberately. This is the required skill-routing-maintenance consult for a description edit made during stage 0 of plans/PLAN-unify-generators.md (deletion of the dead noninterference bridges gen_contract_noninterferent and gen_contract_noninterferent_rel_simple from EndToEnd.v). Three descriptions named the deleted bare lemma and were corrected: cfgver-soundness (chain diagram), cfgver-new-example (recipe's end lemma), cfgver-endtoend (which builder uses which bridge). Classified against this skill's step-0 table as NOT a routing problem: there was no misfire, no wrong winner, no silent non-fire, and no query whose expected winner changes. The edit is a stale-fact correction, and in every case the replacement string keeps `gen_contract_noninterferent` as a proper substring (-> `gen_contract_noninterferent_param`), so every keyword match that fired before still fires. Trigger territory is unchanged by construction.
note: Cost arithmetic was done before deciding, per this skill's 'scope before you spend' rule: the 3 edited skills plus 1-2 near-neighbours each is ~6 queries at ~30k = ~180k tokens, to validate a change predicted a priori to be routing-neutral. That was put to the user rather than spent on the assistant's own authority. If routing validation is wanted later, the queries to run are the cfgver-soundness / cfgver-endtoend / cfgver-new-example should-trigger entries already in eval_set.json plus cfgver-gen-contract as the standing near-neighbour of all three. No eval_set.json entries were added: there is no misfire to regression-guard, and adding entries that encode no new decision would inflate the set's cost floor for every future run. Two further description-level references were left ALONE on purpose -- cfgver-gen-contract:11/:17 and rocq-compile-oom:22 use the family shorthand `gen_contract_noninterferent(_param/_rel)`, which still names real lemmas when the parenthetical is read as required rather than optional; editing them would carry routing risk for no accuracy gain.
summary: 0 queries run. 3 description edits applied (cfgver-soundness, cfgver-new-example, cfgver-endtoend), all verified to leave YAML frontmatter parsing and to preserve the pre-existing trigger keywords. Routing deliberately not re-validated; rationale and the cost that was declined are recorded above so a later reader cannot mistake this for a clean judge run.
